name: agentic-engineering
description: A dozen plugins list about eighty skills, and a job does not say which one it needs, so this is one plugin: a person types /agentic-engineering:start-here and is asked what they want; an agent calls one of thirteen areas by name (agent-works, agentic-teamwork, but-first-planning, code-diet, codebase-optimizer, context-doctor, docs-parity, perceptual-loop, picture-this, plugin-workbench, system-map, workflow-studio, write-like-me); and each area routes to its own procedures, read as documents that cost nothing until one is taken.

syncIntervalSeconds.title: Remote sync interval
syncIntervalSeconds.description: Seconds between runs of `aw board remote sync` while the /kanban pane is open on a board with remote sync on (30 at least).
